titulo: Sunday night: one line for the person with a big Monday
caption:
Sunday night: one line for the person with a big Monday

Sunday night. Dani starts a new job tomorrow, so Cella writes one line and sends it: good luck, Dani.

For whoever knows someone's Monday is a big one.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with a voice on a flat color background of a dark blue room. At the top, the words: Sunday night. Dani starts a new job tomorrow. A small doorway-shaped figure with white eyes stands to the left of a wall calendar page that says JAN and MON, and a plain dark phone with no face stands upright on a small table on the right. The words appear one line at a time: one line (typing dots pulse on the phone). Good luck, Dani (a blue message bubble with those words appears on the phone screen). I hit send (the bubble flies across to the calendar page). It lands on Monday (a red ring draws around MON and a star appears, her eyes close in a smile). The closing line: for whoever knows someone's Monday is big. Then: Choose friction.
comentario_fijado: Cella sent one line tonight. Somebody has a big Monday.
evolucion: Dos apuestas (junta-ene-s1, seccion 3). (a) El cierre con persona, sin pedido: ninguna pieza pide guardar, comentar, compartir, enviar ni seguir (regla 8); el fijado es una frase de Cella que nombra al destinatario. Base de lectura: N2 16 % (14 de 88 Reels), 1,5 envios por 1.000 de alcance, mediana de alcance 117; con el mismo corte de la hora 168. (b) El destinatario como gancho: brazo A (abre con "For whoever ..." en el cuadro 0 y vuelve a cerrar) contra brazo B (solo cierra). Se mide a 48 h con medir.py (envios por 1.000 de alcance, vistas comprometidas) y a 7 dias con objetivos.py (N2, N4). Con 17 seguidores no separa causa de ruido: lectura de orden de magnitud. Semana sin largos ni medios (prueba 3a del acta).
